playstyle.identity: Kha'Zix is an evolving assassin who hunts isolated targets. His abilities upgrade at 6/11/16, and he one-shots anyone caught alone.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive makes next auto deal bonus damage from stealth/brush. Q is single target (massive bonus on isolated). W fires spikes that heal. E leaps. R goes invisible 2-3 times. Evolve Q for damage, E for resets, or R for invisibility. Hunt isolated targets.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kha'Zix spikes at each evolution (6, 11, 16). Duskblade and lethality scale him. He's strong at assassinating isolated targets.

passive.name: Unseen Threat
passive.summary: From stealth or brush, next auto deals bonus damage and slows.
passive.details: When Kha'Zix is unseen, his next basic attack against a champion deals bonus magic damage and slows them.

abilities.name: Taste Their Fear
abilities.summary: Slash an enemy; deals massive bonus damage if they're isolated.
abilities.details: Kha'Zix slashes a target, dealing physical damage. If the target is isolated (no allies nearby), the damage is massively increased. Evolve: Increases range and refunds cooldown on isolated targets.

abilities.name: Void Spike
abilities.summary: Fire spikes that slow; heal if they hit champions.
abilities.details: Kha'Zix fires spikes that damage and slow. If he's hit by the explosion, he heals. Evolve: Fires 3 spikes in a cone and applies passive slow.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.summary: Leap to a location. Evolve: longer range and resets on kill.
abilities.details: Kha'Zix leaps to a location, dealing damage on landing. Evolve: Increased range and the cooldown resets on champion takedown.

abilities.name: Void Assault
abilities.summary: Go invisible briefly; can cast multiple times. Evolve: 3 casts and longer stealth.
abilities.details: Kha'Zix becomes invisible and gains movement speed. Can be cast again within a few seconds. Evolve: Can be cast 3 times and duration is increased.
